seo.title: 6-Day Morocco Tour from Casablanca | Chefchaouen, Fes & Desert (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €590 pp. 6-day Morocco tour from Casablanca to Marrakech (private 4x4 or shared). Hassan II Mosque, Chefchaouen, Fes medina & Erg Chebbi Sahara camp.
seo.lead: A 6-day private Morocco expedition connecting Atlantic coast landmarks, imperial capitals, and Sahara dunes. Starting with pickup in Casablanca, the itinerary visits the grand Hassan II Mosque, the blue mountain alleys of Chefchaouen, Roman Volubilis, the medieval artisan quarters of Fes, a sunset camel trek across Merzouga's Erg Chebbi dunes, and the dramatic High Atlas route into Marrakech.
secondaryKeywords: Morocco tour with Chefchaouen and desert

price.label: From EUR 590 per person
price.note: Price includes private air-conditioned vehicle with dedicated Berber driver-guide, 4 nights in boutique riads/hotels (Chefchaouen, Fes, Dades Valley), 1 night in Erg Chebbi desert bivouac, guided historical walking tour in Fes, camel trek, dinners, and daily breakfasts.

seo.imageAlt: Morocco tour route from Casablanca through Chefchaouen blue medina, imperial Fes, Erg Chebbi desert dunes, and Marrakech
highlights: Visit the majestic oceanfront Hassan II Mosque in Casablanca and the Kasbah of the Udayas in Rabat
Wander the serene cobalt-blue mountain streets and artisan squares of Chefchaouen
Discover the ancient Roman mosaics at Volubilis and the grand Bab Mansour gate in Meknes
Full-day guided walking tour inside the labyrinthine medieval medina of Fes el-Bali
Camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes for sunset, Berber drums by the campfire, and desert stargazing
Journey through Todra Gorges, the Valley of Roses, and UNESCO Kasbah Ait Ben Haddou to Marrakech

faqs.question: Can this 6-day tour collect us directly from Casablanca Airport (CMN)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your private driver meets you directly in the arrival hall of Casablanca Mohammed V International Airport (CMN) with a personalized greeting board, or collects you from your Casablanca city hotel at your chosen time.

faqs.question: Is a certified local guide included for the medina of Fes?
faqs.answer: Yes. In Fes, an official licensed historical guide joins you for an in-depth walking tour through the 9,000 alleys of Fes el-Bali, visiting Al-Qarawiyyin University, Bou Inania Madrasa, and the iconic Chouara Tanneries.

faqs.question: What is the driving pace on this 6-day cross-country journey?
faqs.answer: The route is carefully calibrated to balance sightseeing with comfortable driving legs. The longest driving day is Day 4 (Fes to Merzouga, ~7 hours), broken up by stops in Ifrane, the Azrou cedar forest, and the Ziz Valley.

faqs.question: What accommodations are included during the 6 days?
faqs.answer: Accommodations feature authentic boutique riads in Chefchaouen, Fes, and Dades Valley, plus an equipped desert camp in the Erg Chebbi dunes. Luxury upgrades with private ensuite bathrooms and air conditioning/heating are available.

faqs.question: Can extra nights be added in Chefchaouen, Fes, or Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes. Because this is an exclusive private tour, extra nights, side excursions to Essaouira, or tailored itinerary modifications can be effortlessly incorporated into your booking.
